jobs: Dark Age look in the spirit of Age of Empires 2: a compact, tidy, well-proportioned building whose walls stand square on a low footing of rough grey fieldstone, walls of vertical split-oak planks and dark timber posts, a roof of neat wooden shingles (not thatch) with crisp straight ridges and short eaves that do not overhang the footprint, so the whole building fills its square plot cleanly. Warm, readable, sturdy; poorer than a stone town but not a hovel. Make this the Dark Age Town Center: a timber great hall with a raised central block and a small square lookout tower of timber on one corner, a wide double plank door under a porch, a ring of sharpened palisade stakes only at the two front corners, smoke from a roof louvre, one tall pennant on the tower.

Make this a Castle Age siege workshop: a large solid workshop of dressed grey stone ground floor and heavy dark timber frame upper storey under a steep slate-grey roof, with a tall wide arched timber gate on the front through which a battering ram is half visible, a half-built trebuchet arm and stacked beams in a small walled yard at one corner. It sits flat and square on its plot, with no dark rim or shadow under it. Clearly a stronger, later-age building than a wooden yard.
